newsitem.title: UK: Novorossiisk crude pipelines due back Thurs/Fri.
newsitem.headline: Novorossiisk crude pipelines due back Thurs/Fri.

text.p: The two crude pipelines feeding Russia's Novorossiisk oil export terminal are due to come back up on Thursday and Friday after maintenance, traders and shipping sources said on Wednesday.

The small pipeline (500-1,000 tonnes per hour) is expected to reopen at 1700 hours local time on Thursday while the large pipeline (3,500 tonnes per hour) is due back on stream around midday local time on Friday.
Both lines were closed for maintenance at 0600 GMT on Tuesday morning. The shore-based oil storage tanks were empty when the pipelines closed.

Mediterranean crude traders expected the first tanker to load in Novorossiisk on Friday or Saturday. The largest of the four crude loading berths in Novorossiisk is due to close for repairs from December 9 to 24.
